observation.command: cd /workspace; sed -n '60,140p' composer.json; echo "---lock platform---"; grep -A20 '"platform"' composer.lock | head -40; echo "---lock content-hash php---"; php -r '$l=json_decode(file_get_contents("composer.lock"),true); echo $l["platform"]["php"]??"none","\n"; foreach($l["packages"] as $p){ if($p["name"]==="laravel/framework") echo "laravel/framework: ",$p["version"]," requires php ",$p["require"]["php"]??"?","\n"; }'
